items.title: William "Ba Ba" Ridgley Interview, 1959-06-02
items.q: We called him Brock, I believe his name was Brock Umford. But that was the only man I can remember in Bowling band.

ctx.x: Can you remember any other members of that Bowling band at that time?

Remember any clarinet? Let me see, I know they had the guitar player. We called him Brock, I believe his name was Brock Umford. But that was the only man I can remember in Bowling band. I'm sure I knew more of them, but they've gone from my name now.
Can you remember about what instruments he used?
